title: Shadow Merge Queue receipt
description: SECB-WP-FWK-083, issue #149. Records whether an ORDERED queue drains, which is a different claim from each PR being individually mergeable. PR_IS_INDIVIDUALLY_MERGEABLE != ORDERED_PREFIX_IS_INTEGRABLE != INTEGRATED_RESULT_PASSES_TESTS != GITHUB_REQUIRED_CHECKS_PASSED. A receipt conforming to this schema confers NO merge authority and creates no queue entry.

merge_method.description: Must equal the repository's method. A prefix built the wrong way measures a tree that will never exist.

environment.description: A pass is only meaningful against the environment that produced it.

unmeasured_suffix.description: Entries the budget did not reach. The first of these is NOT failing; it is unmeasured, which is a different fact.

attribution.description: Required whenever a prefix fails: FIRST_FAILING_PREFIX_AT_PR_N is not PR_N_IS_SOLE_CAUSE. The failure belongs to the combination.
